title: Prime Minister congratulates Neeru and Kynan Chenai on winning Gold in Trap Mixed Team event at Asian Games 2026
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Neeru and Kynan Chenai on winning the Gold medal in the Trap Mixed Team event at the Asian Games 2026.
Shri Modi noted that the Indian pair created an Asian Record in the Final to secure India’s first-ever Asian Games Gold medal in the event.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office said;
“Congratulations to Neeru and Kynan Chenai on bringing home the Gold in the Trap Mixed Team event at the 2026 Asian Games.
The Indian pair created an Asian Record in the Final to secure India’s first-ever Asian Games Gold in this event.
A memorable achievement for Indian shooting. Well done to both athletes! May they always shine in the times to come: PM @narendramodi”
